verdict.rationale: EmailOctopus is a SaaS email-marketing platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis. The evidence pack documents only a REST API and third-party integrations, with no MCP server. The REST API is a developer building block and earns no credit here, and the probes for llms.txt, markdown docs and an OpenAPI spec all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
